assets.name: 箭步：上砍
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: 1000x760 landscape game card artwork only. Reference 1 is the STRICT pose to reproduce, reference 2 is ONLY Wylder's armor/weapon identity, reference 3 controls the simple graphic card rendering. Render as graphic flat 2D fantasy card illustration, bold black silhouette and hard-edged cel planes, simplified navy/silver/brown palette, 2-3 tones per material, NOT detailed metal, NOT painted/realistic. Closed feather-wing silver helmet and dark visor, black scarf, navy split coat with a few white flowing water motifs, grouped silver scales and brown wrapped boots. Sword: ONE long rigid straight greatsword, forked sculptural pommel from ref2 (not ball), grip/guard/blade/tip on one ruler-straight axis. No text, UI, card frame, extra limbs, gritty texture or dust speckles. Recreate reference1's anatomical pose faithfully by dressing the mannequin, do not copy the idle pose. Upright fully extended torso centered at x50%, head turns to screen RIGHT. RIGHT arm goes from shoulder at screen-left up and left, right glove firmly gripping sword above head at x25% y18%. Blade rises almost vertically to top-left, may exit top border; pommel below right hand remains visible. LEFT arm on screen-right is bent upward with free fist above helmet and to its right. Both elbows high, hands clearly separate; only right hand grips sword. Asymmetric armor: simple silver plate over navy on RIGHT shoulder, layered ornate silver plates and grappling bracer on LEFT arm. Chest visible, no shield concealing arms. Legs in a narrow front-back stepping stance per ref1, NOT broad squat. Camera three-quarter front, no reversal or mirror. Keep helmet/torso in central safe area and joint chains readable. One slim white rising slash scrape to far left of sword, no fire and no closed ring. Background: pale warm limestone gray with just two large dark vertical shadow blocks on left, substantial quiet warm-gray negative space on right. Simplify to big flat shapes, little engraving.
assets.edit_prompt: Precise-object-edit: edit IMAGE1 only the sword POMMEL BELOW the raised gripping hand. It is incorrectly a small round hexagonal ring. Replace it with Wylder's distinctive long sculptural FORKED/CRESCENT pommel from IMAGE2: two curled metal prongs branching sideways, open crescent silhouette, not a ball or ring. Preserve entire pose, helmet, hands, background, flat graphic shading and framing exactly. Keep vertical sword axis straight: blade, guard center, navy grip and forked pommel stem collinear. Do not change the curved guard above hand. 1000x760 landscape card illustration no text/UI.

assets.name: 箭步：回旋斩
assets.prompt: Repaint IMAGE 1 as a flat-color fantasy card illustration. KEEP the mannequin's EXACT pose and viewing angle. Dress the mannequin in Wylder's outfit from IMAGE 2: silver winged closed helmet, black scarf, navy coat with white flowing motifs, silver scale sleeves, brown wraps. Ignore IMAGE 2's pose. We see the hunched BACK, not chest. RIGHT hand alone holds a greatsword behind him on screen-left, angled down-left. The LEFT arm reaches FORWARD, left forearm horizontal in front of body, empty fist on screen-right. Keep shoulder/elbow/wrist positions, torso tilt, deeply bent front knee and rear foot exactly as image1. Do not straighten the crouched body or use low-angle camera. No front V breastplate or belt buckle on his BACK. Sword must be rigid straight: long silver blade, navy grip and distinctive open FORKED pommel (not ball). Keep right hand holding sword and left hand empty, not mirrored. One weapon. Flat hard-edged 2D blocks, bold black shapes, minimal surface detail. Landscape 1000x760, subject centered. Dark plum backdrop with two calm horizontal gray-olive ground planes. Thin white horizontal sweep trace behind waist. No circular halo, fire, debris, text, border or UI. Prioritize the exact anatomical silhouette of image1.
